title: Prototype D · Quiet
description: Shows nothing unless something is wrong. One number, one list, and how long the disks last.

targets.expr:
count(
sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"} == 1, "what", "Pod not running", "", ""), "where", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(round(sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h]))) > 0, "what", "Restarts in 24 h", "", ""), "where", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(argocd_app_info{sync_status!="Synced"}, "what", "App out of sync", "", ""), "where", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(argocd_app_info{health_status!="Healthy"}, "what", "App unhealthy", "", ""), "where", "$1", "name", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(longhorn_volume_robustness{state=~"degraded|faulted"} == 1, "what", "Volume degraded", "", ""), "where", "$1", "pvc", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes) > 80, "what", "Volume over 80 % full", "", ""), "where", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace((((time() - longhorn_volume_last_backup_at) / 3600 > 36) and (longhorn_volume_last_backup_at > 0)) and on (pvc, pvc_namespace) label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_recurring_job_group_longhorn_io_backup="enabled"}, "pvc", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)"), "pvc_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"), "what", "Hours since last backup", "", ""), "where", "$1", "pvc", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(((longhorn_volume_last_backup_at == 0) and on (pvc, pvc_namespace) label_replace(label_replace(kube_persistentvolumeclaim_labels{label_recurring_job_group_longhorn_io_backup="enabled"}, "pvc", "$1", "persistentvolumeclaim", "(.*)"), "pvc_namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)")) + 1, "what", "Opted in, never backed up", "", ""), "where", "$1", "pvc", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(longhorn_backup_state == 4, "what", "Backup in error", "", ""), "where", "$1", "volume", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(up == 0, "what", "Scrape target down", "", ""), "where", "$1", "job", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_node_status_condition{condition=~"DiskPressure|MemoryPressure|PIDPressure",status="true"} == 1, "what", "Node pressure", "", ""), "where", "$1", "condition", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(kube_job_status_failed > 0, "what", "Job failed", "", ""), "where", "$1", "job_name", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace(ALERTS{alertstate="firing",alertname!~"Watchdog|InfoInhibitor"}, "what", "Alert firing", "", ""), "where", "$1", "alertname", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace((100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!="rootfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{job="node-exporter",mountpoint="/",fstype!="rootfs"})) > 85, "what", "Root disk % used", "", ""), "where", "$1", "mountpoint", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace((100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter"})) > 92, "what", "Memory % used", "", ""), "where", "$1", "job", "(.*)"))
 or sum by (what, where) (label_replace(label_replace((max by (chip) (node_hwmon_temp_celsius{chip!~"nvme.*|ieee80211.*"})) > 85, "what", "CPU °C", "", ""), "where", "$1", "chip", "(.*)"))
) or vector(0)

panels.description: Age of the stalest backup among volumes opted in to daily backups.

options.content:
Listed above only when outside its limit: a pod not running · any restart in 24 h · an Argo CD app out of sync or unhealthy · a Longhorn volume degraded or a backup in error · a volume over 80 % full · a volume not backed up for 36 h · a scrape target down · node disk, memory, or PID pressure · a failed job · a firing alert · root disk over 85 % · memory over 92 % · CPU over 85 °C.

Active alerts also go to ntfy; this page is for the things that are not alerts yet.
